description: Save the project API key for local runners in <folder>/.testchimp/mcp.json (Studio format: mode 0600, dir 0700, .testchimp/ gitignored) and map the folder in ~/.testchimp/projects.json. Fetches the key with the current MCP auth — do not pass the key, and the response never includes it. Local stdio MCP only (omitted on hosted mcp.testchimp.io). Hosted / plugin agents: call get-project-credentials and write <repo>/.testchimp/mcp.json with a file-write tool (never put the key in a shell command).

folder.description: Repository root on the machine running this MCP server. Writes <folder>/.testchimp/mcp.json (mode 0600, dir 0700) and maps the folder in ~/.testchimp/projects.json. Hosted mcp.testchimp.io cannot write your laptop — call get-project-credentials and write <repo>/.testchimp/mcp.json with a file-write tool (mode 0600, dir 0700).

projectId.description: Defaults to the connection's project from get-project-credentials.

reassign.description: Replace another project's key in this folder and move the folder mapping to this project.
